description.value: Surf Grove sits at Cox Bay — Canada's top-rated surf beach — 7 km south of Tofino, with forested semi-serviced tent sites featuring 15-amp power, showers, and wi-fi just a short walk from the sand. A polished, year-round commercial campground with top-tier amenities; expect crowds and premium pricing.

address.value: 1451 Pacific Rim Hwy, PO Box 1109, Tofino BC V0R2Z0 Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The surfgrove.com website loaded fully and provides strong primary evidence: full-service RV sites list water service and shower facilities, semi-serviced sites list 15 amp/120V AC electrical service and washroom/shower facilities, the Ukee Poke Food Truck is confirmed on-site, and the homepage promotes an online booking system. OSM tags corroborate the camp_site category and note a sanitary dump station for customers. No explicit hiker/biker designated site category, cyclist discount, laundry, or camping fuel is mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record lacks phone number and address; both sourced from website content only.
E-bike charging not explicitly confirmed for guest bikes despite on-site e-bike rental service that implies charging infrastructure exists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established, actively operating beachside campground on the Pacific Rim route with strong amenities for touring cyclists including showers, water, electrical hookups, on-site food, and bicycle rentals.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website also highlights on-site electric bike rentals and a free summer shuttle from near the campground gate. The FAQ confirms cyclists can rent bikes on-site and notes a bike path to Tofino town (~20 min ride).

wow_evidence: Cox Bay — Canada's top-rated surf beach — 7 km south of Tofino
